source: Track F gates F1 to F9 of the owner's NYC-Tron UI 1.0.0 and Nitro Forge v1 program (revision 3, 2026-11-11). Acceptance text is copied from it unchanged. References to §2.5, §3.3, §4 and §5 point at that program; F1 carries its §5 Forge rows below, and F8.1 moves §2.5 into design/DIRECTION.md.
evidenceRule: Evidence rule for every gate: implement, capture evidence with date and commit in its path, have the reviewer inspect the actual result, and only then change status. A file existing does not prove the claim inside it.
passedRequires: status passed needs an evidence path that exists in this repository, the full 40-character commit the evidence was captured at, the signing reviewer and the review date. tooling/validate-v1.mjs enforces this.

gates.title: Packages updated
acceptance: §5 table done; build, typecheck, `cargo test --locked --workspace`, package suites and all 22 workflows pass on the new graph.

versionBaseline.rule: Updating packages is a requirement. Every Bump lands; every Hold gets a one-line reason in the support or compatibility document. Then run `pnpm outdated -r` and dispose of every remaining item the same way.

rows.action: Bump; regenerate bindings; run native suites

gates.statusReason: Dependency baseline #78, cargo-audit #83 and F2 #85 are merged. The dated F1 routine slice records Expo58.0.25/tooling patches, both locks, all32 manifest/peer/override/source declarations and actual nonzero root/native pnpm outdated output. Skia/WebGPU/SVG have a separate stacked native trial planned; CLI20.2 is tied to the published RN0.88.1 template. Known Rust migration/vendor ABI holds and the macro workaround remain explicit. New CI collection covers full suites, both generators, dated audit database and freshness output, with original22 workflow coverage still requiring actual exact-head executions and independent review. No F1 pass is claimed.

gates.title: Tron pin
acceptance: Repin to Tron `rc.2` when it exists and to `1.0.0` when it exists. Each repin updates `tooling/nyc-tron.json` and every `@nyc-tron` reference, regenerates lockfiles, runs `verify-nyc-tron-pin.mjs --download`, typechecks the wired rows and runs their tests. Forge v1 does not ship pinned to a prerelease.
gates.statusReason: The published Tron v1.0.0-rc.2 cohort at 0e09d3be8263b3dbb2eab1a78e5dd66b83b68e44 is pinned in tooling/nyc-tron.json and all consumer manifests; both locks were regenerated with pnpm 12.18.0. The repin is under independent R2 review and needs candidate-bound installed consumer/type/runtime CI. The later stable Tron 1.0.0 repin is still pending; Forge v1 cannot ship pinned to this prerelease.

gates.title: Deferred rows
acceptance: Three rows are open in `docs/NYC_TRON_UI_HANDOFF.md`:
- Pivot field list: the filter zone needs at least one value, which the component does not provide.
- Beat marker lane: no engine parameter for its sensitivity control.
- Blend and opacity: no engine op for its premultiplied-alpha option.

Each needs a component change in Tron or a new engine op in Forge. That is a design decision. For each, write a one-page proposal with both options, the API change, and the test, then stop and report. Implement after the owner chooses. A component change goes into Tron before `rc.2`.
gates.statusReason: docs/proposals/F3-deferred-rows.md exists. PR #81 implemented the recorded option-B Tally pivot and Cadence sensitivity/marker operations and merged as a58994d4802de2db9067ae3cbe824912c4a50b9c. Source-bound browser receipts at tested merge 0c8ba55452fb7dd952d6c933dd56071862f350c3 cover All-filter refresh, undo/redo, beat detection and marker rename/tick preservation. The Prism B11 alphaModes Forge catalog wiring and its row tests/render review remain incomplete; the three-row gate has no full acceptance signature. Proposal and historical source identities are preserved.

gates.title: App identity and rebranding
acceptance: 1. Apply gate T3 to every Forge app using Tron's check: icon set, full name, short launcher name, bundle identifier and Android package. Fix "forge-media-controls-lab" and give both labs identifiers.

2. Each studio has its own icon, drawn as one family in the §2.5 spirit: shared grid, shared construction, one distinguishing form and colour per studio, so the set reads as one suite on a home screen. Run §3.3 on the icon family, with the §2.2 icon designers as the bar. Test at 16, 32, 60 and 1024 pixels.

3. Studios are separately installable and rebrandable by a name replace. Put product name, short name, identifiers and icon paths in one brand manifest per studio that config plugins read. A rebrand test replaces the name and proves the app builds with no old name left in the app label, title bar, About screen or bundle metadata.
gates.statusReason: Brand manifests, icon assets and rebrand checks are present in the inspected master baseline a58994d4. On 2026-11-13 the owner accepted the earlier iPhone Duo launcher captures as the F4 design-reference basis. These remain iOS simulator captures of stub launcher bundles, not iPad or studio runtime proof. See design/F4-REFERENCE-DECISION-2026-11-13.md for the exact captures and remaining T3 adoption, platform/rebrand build, rendered-surface and owner-review criteria. No gate acceptance or reviewer signature is inferred.

gates.title: Desktop target and window chrome
acceptance: 1. ADR and owner decision: which studios get a desktop build for v1. Default proposal: the suite app and one studio on macOS through Spark, since Tron's AppKit lane already runs there; Windows after.

2. Use Tron's window title bar from T2, themed by Forge's tokens so drawn controls follow the §2.5 radius rule. Document windows get the document name in the title bar, an edited indicator, and a close guard for unsaved changes wired to the Ignition journal.
3. Menus and shortcuts through Spark's menu and shortcut modules, mapped to the same commands the toolbars use.
4. On iPad, verify every studio's top toolbar clears the system window controls when the app is windowed.

5. Note the runtime mismatch: Forge is on React Native 0.88.1 and Nitro v1 alpha, while the Spark lane is on 0.83.10 with Nitro 0.37. State what that means for loading the Rust engines on desktop before promising a desktop studio, and stop to report if it blocks.
gates.statusReason: F5 desktop scope was struck from Forge v1 on 2026-11-13 by the integrator (A0) on the owner's instruction to drop the spike; owner confirmation is pending. See docs/proposals/F5-desktop-scope.md for the ABI/runtime return condition. No desktop spike or desktop native target ran for this record, and every studio still needs iPad windowed-mode toolbar-clearance verification. The acceptance text and validator remain unchanged; this strike does not pass F5.

gates.title: Expo consumer path
acceptance: For each studio package: in a new Expo app, install from release tarballs, add the config plugin, prebuild, and open, edit, save, reopen and undo a document on iOS and Android. No hand-edited native files. Add a clean-consumer smoke job like Tron's `consumer-smoke.mjs` and run it in CI against the produced tarballs.
gates.statusReason: Forge produces no release tarballs yet and has no clean-consumer smoke job. examples/native-cadence consumes workspace sources, not tarballs.

gates.title: Platform evidence
acceptance: Fresh receipts at the candidate commit for the Rust engines, the C ABI, iOS and Android native apps, and web. `ROSTER.md` and `compatibility.v1.json` agree with each other and with the receipts. Anything not run says NOT RUN.
gates.statusReason: Source-bound browser receipts now exist: PR #82 launcher/Prism shell at tested merge 370e10b6b2c95ddeeeb2ae0ad89815e5305c884f, and PR #81 Tally/Cadence real-engine interactions at 0c8ba55452fb7dd952d6c933dd56071862f350c3. compatibility.v1.json and ROSTER.md mark web partial. Active F2 PR #85 head f6b6e17e0600fcb1f8e14023a1692026738daaa7 has separate partial CI at tested merge 2463139896b61e8bfe49a2ad6dd2da50fb02043a; its two native workflows were still running at the captured snapshot. Fresh complete Rust/C ABI/native runtime/web receipts at one final candidate remain outstanding. Older simulator/emulator receipts are not relabeled; physical-device and wider platform work remain NOT RUN.

gates.title: Design pass
acceptance: The brief in §2.5 governs.
1. Update `design/DIRECTION.md` with the §2.5 brief and the radius rule, so the direction lives in the repository and not only in this prompt.

2. Radius: define the two tokens once in the shared Forge theme and remove every other radius value. Add a check under `tooling/` that fails CI on any `View` (or component rendering one) styled with `rounded-lg` and larger, on arbitrary `rounded-[...]` values, on per-app radius variables, and on raw numeric `borderRadius` outside the token file and the documented exemptions. Wire it into `validate:v1`.
3. Run the full §3.3 sequence on every studio. The design-critique step answers the §2.5 question for that studio in writing, with captures beside the reference.

4. The cross-studio consistency table from the design-system step has no unexplained differences: same switcher, toolbar, context toolbar, panel, inspector and popover construction in all seven studios and both labs.
5. Micro-interactions, responsive behaviour and native popovers and menus are present in every studio, not only the ones reviewed first.

Acceptance: the radius check passing with zero exemptions beyond those listed in §2.5; a view-by-view radius inventory per studio showing outer views at `rounded-md` and inner views at `rounded-sm`; side-by-side captures of all studios at iPad size showing one grammar; the critique record for each studio.
gates.statusReason: PR #86 merged the owner’s §2.5 suite brief and two-token radius direction into design/DIRECTION.md at b000c8ab9f8201bcba3c67163f6c8f700acf6453. This completes the direction-document piece only. Shared token migration, the radius validator wired into validate:v1, view-by-view inventory, full §3.3 per-studio critique, cross-studio consistency and iPad-size captures, interactions and native accessibility evidence remain incomplete. No full design acceptance or gate signature is claimed.

gates.title: Release
acceptance: Follow `RELEASE_TRAIN.md`: one tarball per package plus `SHA256SUMS`, attached to a GitHub Release. First a `1.0.0-rc.1` prerelease, then v1 after the owner approves the exact version and checksum hash, the same way Tron's stable gate works. Set real versions; the root is still `0.0.0`.
